💬 What to Expect:
The Keep It Simple group offers a calm, encouraging space for anyone seeking recovery through the Narcotics Anonymous program. Weekly meetings focus on topic-based sharing — often grounded in NA literature or spiritual principles — providing inspiration and identification for both newcomers and long-timers.

After the meeting, we invite everyone for fellowship over coffee at the garage across the road — a relaxed way to connect and feel part of the community.

🙌 Encouragement for Newcomers:
We understand it’s not easy walking into a meeting for the first time. That’s why we make a point not to spotlight newcomers — we let you integrate at your own pace. Whether you're here to listen or share, you're welcome.

You never have to use again. You're not alone.

✨ Features & Access:
✅ Friendly, welcoming, and newcomer-conscious
✅ Wheelchair accessible, gender-neutral restrooms
✅ LGBTIQ+ inclusive & youth-friendly
✅ WhatsApp group for announcements
